name: Hengroen

attributes.attribute: named in the Welsh Triads as the horse of King Arthur in the final battle at Camlan

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Hengroen is an Arthurian figure. His other name is Llamrei. The Welsh Triads name Hengroen as the horse of King Arthur. Arthur rode him in the final battle at Camlan.

okr.objective: Document Hengroen, the horse of King Arthur.
key_results: Describe his place in the Welsh Triads.
Note that Arthur rode him at the final battle at Camlan.
